PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 9, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, January 9, 2020,
at 2:05 pm in the Council Chambers, 9st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Deputy Treasurer, City Treasurer
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
December 12, 2019.

Special Event Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Mike Hellyar DBA GC Event Productions to host Alter Ego at The Forum –
  3900 W. Manchester Boulevard, on Saturday, January 18, 2020, from 3:00
  p.m. - 6:30 p.m. Approved for one day event in forum parking lot; applicant
  responsible for crowd control and event clean up; applicant to have
  additional Forum Security staff with Security coverage by Inglewood PD or
  Forum Security personnel (NOT LAPD); NO Alcohol sales or consumption;
  Two (2) Code Enforcement Officers assigned for noise mitigation pursuant
  to IMC Chapter 5; applicant to call and schedule with the Code
  Enforcement Division sound check PRIOR to the event commencing
  (310.412.5590 Monday - Thursday 7:30am - 5:30pm); and Applicant to
  provide name and phone number of sound technician; comply with city's
  noise standards pursuant to IMC Chapter 5; adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, and all local, state and federal laws, in addition to the terms &
  conditions of the permit issued. Motion carried and second. (Activity No.
  00295755)

New Business License Request(s):

Item #2:  Nelson & Luis Mediavilla DBA Video Entertainment Center 2 to operate an
  Adult Video Rental/Sales at 10301 Hawthorne Blvd. Applicant must comply
  with all applicable regulations of IMC 12-94.2 specifically:
 Permits & License Committee  January 9, 2020
Minutes  Page 2 of 7

  (1)  All adult oriented businesses shall have clearly visible signs at all entrances
  specifying “ADULTS ONLY”; “NO MINORS PERMITTED” or equivalent
  wording. Said notice shall consist of letters no less than one inch in height.
  No person under the age of eighteen shall be permitted within the premises
  at any time.

  (2)  No adult-oriented business shall be operated in any manner that permits the
  observation of any material or activities depicting, describing or relating to
  “Specified Sexual Activities” or “Specified Anatomical Areas” from any
  public way or from any location outside the building area of such
  establishment. This provision shall apply to any display, decoration, sign,
  show window or other opening. No exterior door or window on the premises
  shall be propped or kept open at any time while the business is open, and
  any exterior windows shall be covered with opaque covering at all times.

  (3)  All off-street parking areas and premises entries of the adult-oriented business
  shall be illuminated from dusk to closing hours of operation with a lighting
  system which provides an average maintained horizontal illumination of
  one foot candle of light on the parking surface and/or walkways.

  (4)  All indoor areas of the adult-oriented business within which patrons are permitted,
  except rest rooms, shall be open to view by the management and City
  inspectors at all times.

  (5)  An adult oriented business shall be open for business only between the hours of
  eight a.m. and two a.m. any particular day unless otherwise modified by
  this Code or as a condition of a Special Use Permit.
  (C) Adult Arcade. Additional Required Conditions.

  (1)  The number of film or video viewing machines or booths in any
  adult arcade shall not exceed one machine per thirty square
  feet of floor area.

  (2)  There shall be no doors or closable screens on video or film
  viewing booths in any adult arcade. The interior of the
  premises shall be configured in such a manner that there is
  an unobstructed view from a manager’s station of every
  area of the premises to which any patron is permitted
  access for any purpose, excluding restrooms. Restrooms
  may not contain video reproduction equipment. If the
  premises has two or more manager’s stations designated,
  then the interior of the premises shall be configured in such
  a manner that there is an unobstructed view of each area of
  the premises to which any patron is permitted access for any
  purpose from at least one of the manager’s stations. The
  view required in this subsection must be direct line of sight
  from the manager’s station.

  (3)  The view area specified in subsection (C)(6) shall remain
  unobstructed by any doors, walls, merchandise, display
  racks, or other materials at all times. No patron is permitted
 Permits & License Committee  January 9, 2020
Minutes  Page 3 of 7

  access to any area of the premises which has been
  designated as an area in which patrons will not be permitted.

  (4)  No viewing room may be occupied by more than one person at
  any one time.

  (5)  The walls or partitions between viewing rooms or booths shall be
  maintained in good repair at all times, with no holes between
  two such rooms such as would allow viewing from one booth
  into another or such as to allow physical contact of any kind
  between occupants of any two such booths or rooms.

  (6)  Customers, patrons or visitors shall not be allowed to stand idly
  by in the vicinity of any such video booths, or from remaining
  in the common area of such business, other than the
  restrooms, who are not actively engaged in shopping for or
  reviewing the products available on display for purchaser
  viewing. Signs prohibiting loitering shall be posted in
  prominent places in and near the video booths.

  (7)  The floors, seats, walls and other interior portions of all video
  booths shall be maintained clean and free from waste and
  bodily secretions. Presence of human excrement, urine,
  semen or saliva in any such booths shall be evidence of
  improper maintenance and inadequate sanitary controls;
  repeated instances of such conditions may justify
  suspension or revocation of the owner and operator’s
  license to conduct the adult arcade.
  Applicant/Agent/Employees shall be in possession of their
  government issued identification and present it to any
  authorized official; business is subject to inspection by any
  Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer during normal
  business hours (City Hall) or times the facility is open to the
  public; all special events are subject to Permits & License
  Committee approval and must operate in full compliance
  with all of the applicable conditions set forth in Inglewood
  Municipal Code Section 12-94.2 and all Federal, State, and
  Local laws. (Activity No. 00278039)

Item #3:  Vibian Ibet Ocampo DBA West Beauty and Barber to operate a hair salon
  at 6521 West Blvd. Approval for change of ownership for existing salon in
  C-2 zone; subject to all applicable IMC regulations; applicant shall provide
  current ID and applicable state licensing on all employees; COMPLETE
  Page 1. NO parties/events permitted at any time inside or outside of the
  location (day or night); no loitering in or outside the establishment; no
  consumption of any alcoholic beverages; no narcotic use (including
  cannabis activity) at any time on the premises, no body (bare skin)
  massages or disrobing of any kind; and all employees must adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws. Motion
  carried and second. (Activity No. 00290974)
 Permits & License Committee  January 9, 2020
Minutes  Page 4 of 7

Item #4:  Naixu Li DBA Imperial Transportation International Solutions LTD., to
  operate a car rental at 9133 S. La Cienega Blvd; approval for office use
  only of a car rental business in M-1 zone; no storage of vehicles permitted
  on-site or any adjacent public ROW; applicant shall provide valid ID on
  him/herself and all employees (including any state DMV licenses if
  applicable); all vehicles must be registered; a State of California dealer's
  license and any applicable permits / licenses issued by the California DMV;
  NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs / maintenance on any city
  streets, sidewalks or alleys; and all employees must adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws. Motion
  carried and second. (Activity No. 00290971)

Item #5:  Brenda Reaves DBA Morningside Park Beauty Salon to operate a hair
  salon at 8462 Crenshaw Blvd. Approval for change of ownership for
  existing salon in C-2 zone; subject to all applicable IMC regulations;
  applicant shall provide current ID and applicable state licensing on all
  employees; COMPLETE Page 1. NO parties/events permitted at any time
  inside or outside of the location (day or night); no loitering in or outside the
  establishment; no consumption of any alcoholic beverages; no narcotic use
  (including cannabis activity) at any time on the premises, no body (bare
  skin) massages or disrobing of any kind; and all employees must adhere
  to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00295792)

Item #6:  Brenda Reaves DBA Morningside Park Barbershop to operate a
  Barbershop at 8462 Crenshaw Blvd. Approval for change of ownership for
  existing salon in C-2 zone; subject to all applicable IMC regulations;
  applicant shall provide current ID and applicable state licensing on all
  employees; COMPLETE Page 1. NO parties/events permitted at any time
  inside or outside of the location (day or night); no loitering in or outside the
  establishment; no consumption of any alcoholic beverages; no narcotic use
  (including cannabis activity) at any time on the premises, no body (bare
  skin) massages or disrobing of any kind; and all employees must adhere
  to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00295791)

Item #7:  Marianne Ndiaye and Faye Thierno DBA Serenity Lady to operate a Beauty

  change of ownership for existing salon in C-2 zone; subject to all applicable
  IMC regulations; applicant shall provide current ID and applicable state
  licensing on all employees; COMPLETE Page 1. NO parties/events
  permitted at any time inside or outside of the location (day or night); no
  loitering in or outside the establishment; no consumption of any alcoholic
  beverages; no narcotic use (including cannabis activity) at any time on the
  premises, no body (bare skin) massages or disrobing of any kind; and all
  employees must adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00295788)
